projects.title: All projects
projects.description: The projects Orchester knows on this computer. Each one keeps its tasks, pipelines and settings in its own .orchester folder.
projects.openFolderTitle: Choose a folder with an Orchester project

offer.text: {{team}} shares {{project}} with you. It isn't on this computer yet.

header.teamHint: Working with a team? Join it to see the projects it shares with you.

projects.folderMissingHint: The folder is not there any more. Move it back to open the project, or remove it from the list.

removal.note: Removing a project from this list only makes Orchester forget it. Its folder and the project’s .orchester data stay on disk; open the folder again to bring it back.
removal.title: Remove {{name}} from the list?
removal.explanation: Orchester forgets the project. Nothing is deleted: the folder and the project’s .orchester data, with its tasks, runs, pipelines and settings, stay on disk. Open the folder again to bring the project back.
removal.dataStays: stays on disk · tasks, runs and settings

projects.loadFailed: The projects could not be read

empty.title: No projects in the list
empty.summary: Add a project to set one up in a folder, or open a folder that already has an Orchester project, such as one removed from this list.

errors.noProject: Couldn’t open {{path}} — it has no .orchester project data. Use Add project to set it up as a new project.
errors.notRepository: Couldn’t open {{path}} — it is not a git repository.
errors.notTopFolder: Couldn’t open {{path}} — it is inside the git repository at {{top}}. Open that folder instead.
errors.newerData: Couldn’t open {{path}} — its project data was written by a newer version of Orchester.
errors.notRead: Couldn’t open {{path}} — its project data could not be read. The log has the details.
